sentences.text: % 28.03.2026 Matters taken up today being 02.03.2026 declared holiday.
1. The accused/applicants seek anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 409/2023 of Police Station Chhawla for offence under Section 306/420/34/120B of the IPC.
1.1 These bail applications came up for the first hearing on 05.09.2024 and 23.09.2024 respectively before the predecessor bench and thereafter This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 28/03/2026 at 20:47:46 continued getting adjourned before different benches.
Along with 179 such old pending bail applications, these applications also were transferred to this bench.
1.2 Today is the first hearing before me.

2. In two connected bail applications of the co-accused persons, after watching the suicide video clip, counsel for those accused persons sought permission to withdraw those bail applications and accordingly those anticipatory bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn.
3. Since none appears on behalf of accused/applicants in these two applications, these anticipatory bail applications are dismissed in default.
